item.title: [7.0] MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update...

WHY IT MATTERS

MemT-1.0 introduces a notable architectural shift toward memory-native foundation models using Gated DeltaNet-2 and Mixture-of-Storage, offering an alternative to traditional RAG and parametric memory.
